messages:
deploybot: RELEASE 2025-10-15T22:00Z - blocked by policy: vuln-threshold (>=1 high) exceeded during vuln-scan. SBOM provenance check: transitive package `libx-2.1.4` unpinned. Canary deployment halted. 

maya: ack. seeing the same in the dashboard. can we get details on the CVE and whether it's exploitable in our runtime? :eyes:

jonah: quick triage: CVE-2025-2781 - high severity, affects parsing path that's not used by default config, but repro exists in fuzz harness. Risk is non-zero. attaching snippet from scan: ```
- package: libx
  version: 2.1.4
  issue: CVE-2025-2781
  path: transitive -> parser
```

priya: thanks. deployment window is tonight at 22:00 UTC. options: 1) pin transitive dep to patched 2.1.5 and push hotfix image, 2) rollback the canary to previous image (sha: abc1234) and open postmortem, 3) request change-window-exception from compliance for gradual rollout.

alex: how long to cut a patched image if we pin? engineering estimates ~2 hours including CI, maybe 90m if we skip non-critical integration tests and run smoke only.

maya: we can't skip security tests. but if jonah confirms low exploitability, can we scope a limited canary rollback + mitigations?

jonah: mitigation idea: enable runtime sandbox for canary pods (restrict parsing modules) and proceed with reduced traffic. That avoids full rollback and gives time for a proper patch. I can own the runtime sandbox toggle.

security-bot: POLICY ALERT: Change-window exceptions for security issues require approval from Security and Product ops. Create ticket PRD-2317 and include justification.

priya: creating PRD-2317 now. tagging @security for approval path. If we go sandboxed canary, need a kill switch and monitoring on error rates and CPU.

maya: pragmatic plan: (A) enable sandbox on canary immediately, (B) pause full rollout, (C) start backport/pin branch and build patched image, (D) if patch ready within 3 hours, flip to patched image and proceed; otherwise rollback canary to abc1234. Agree?

alex: +1 for that sequence. I'll prep rollback playbook and test the rollback on staging. playbook snippet: ```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/web --to-revision=42
# verify:
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=web -o wide
```

jonah: I'll enable sandbox and add extra alert on parse-exceptions metric. Will post links to dashboards when set.

maya: security, can you sign off on the exception for sandboxed canary? we need confirmation to proceed before 21:30 UTC.

jonah: added quick mitigation docs here: https://go.redwood/release-mitigation/PRD-2317 (internal).

security-bot: SECURITY: provisional approval granted for sandboxed canary under conditions: monitoring + kill-switch + ticket PRD-2317 created and owner assigned. Full approval pending postmortem if rollout continues.

priya: noted. scheduling rollout pause at 21:50 UTC to enable sandbox and run a 20m smoke. will post status.

maya: thanks all. if anything changes, ping #oncall. otherwise proceed with the sandboxed canary plan and update PRD-2317 with timestamps and indicators. :thumbsup:
